component.name: OpenPulsar
component.summary: Configure Pulsar wired gaming mice on Linux

description.p: OpenPulsar is an open-source configuration utility for Pulsar wired gaming mice on Linux.
It supports profiles, DPI stages, polling rate, debounce, sensor options, button remapping and RGB settings on supported devices.
Added direct DPI value keyboard commands, integrated shortcut conflict handling and a more consistent visual language across keyboard, DPI and RGB controls.
Added complete upstream MIT attribution and refined visual consistency for controls, LED settings and sensor subpanels.
Introduced a first-run project presentation with community links and refined visual consistency throughout the interface.
Improved command selectors by removing duplicate focus outlines and keeping an action category expanded.
Improved keyboard command selection with contextual direct DPI-stage shortcuts and consistent action menus.
Initial public release for supported Pulsar wired gaming mice.
